Part 3 of 3 in our introduction series: What We Do. 🏭

You have met our team and seen our factory. Now here is what matters most to buyers: what our nylon filament can become.

From our factory in Tangerang, we supply filament for:
• Broom bristles
• Brush bristles for floor, toilet, dish/kitchen, laundry and industrial brushes
• Nail brushes and hair brushes
• Shaving/beard brushes and makeup brushes
• Paint brushes
• Fishing line

Need something specific? We produce custom OEM and private label filament, adjusted by color, diameter, length and stiffness. Our Gold Series (Bright Gold and Copper Gold, pearl finish) gives your product range a premium look. Everything is made from recycled plastic raw materials, so performance and sustainability go together. ♻️

Samples are available on request, and you are welcome to visit our factory.

👉 Message us on WhatsApp +62 831-6591-3330 or send us a DM to request samples.

Looking for a reliable nylon filament supplier from Indonesia? Contact us for samples and OEM / private label enquiries. We serve both domestic and export markets.
